banner.note: Dashboard convention (dashboard.py:1303). The wizard's '=== ... ===' (wizard.py:386) migrates to this.

doctor_line.note: Unifies dashboard (dashboard.py:1237-1240, indented, no WARN mark) and CLI (doctor.py:281-289, unindented, has WARN mark): indented + three marks.

menu_group_header.note: Dashboard convention (dashboard.py:1288). The CLI 'FIND:' header (cli.py:369) migrates to this.

section_divider.format: blank line, then 60-col em-dash rule with label
section_divider.note: dashboard.py:199-201. The wizard's '--- Section ---' (wizard.py:389+) migrates to this.

table.format: columns sized by max(header, cell) width; joined with 2 spaces; header row, then a '-' * width rule row per column, then body rows

description: Canonical terminal theme for Veto. Additive over the current uncolored, glyph-based terminal UI: every color role carries a truecolor hex (mapped from the web tokens), an ANSI-256 fallback, a 16-color fallback, and the NO_COLOR glyph/text fallback that is the current behavior. This file is the source of truth; veto_theme.py is the canonical consumer.

layout.note: 2-space body indent and 4-space menu indent are the dominant conventions (dashboard.py:212-216, 1294). The 6-space 'q  Quit' indent (dashboard.py:1299) is retained for that entry.

name: veto-terminal

placeholders.note: Canonical set resolving the current four-way drift: '—' for missing numeric/stat values (dashboard.py:212), '?' for unknown data fields (dashboard.py:330, 935), '(not set)' for unset config (cli.py:249-252), '(none)' for empty lists (cli.py:193).

bg.note: Terminal default background is used today; the value is for truecolor consumers and generated artifacts.

border.note: Maps to web --border-accent (green border semantics). Today borders are glyph-only (box-drawing); the glyph set is the NO_COLOR fallback.

brand.note: Veto brand red (site --veto). NO_COLOR fallback is the letter X, matching the site glyph-allowlist convention for the veto mark.

code.note: Maps to site --cyan / radar compare-series cyan. Reserved for code/identifier spans when color is available.

danger.note: Maps to web --red. NO_COLOR keeps the existing ✕ glyph (dashboard.py:268, 272) and 'Error:' prefix (cli.py:71-73).

display.note: Maps to web --green-neon. Used for display/headline text when color is available; no glyph fallback (falls back to plain text).

info.note: Maps to web --blue. The terminal has no established info glyph; the primary bullet • is the canonical mark for informational lines.

panel.note: Reserved for panel-style terminal blocks if/when added.

success.note: Maps to web --green. NO_COLOR keeps the existing ✓ glyph convention (dashboard.py:262, 276).

warning.note: Maps to web --amber. Canonical warning mark is ⚠ (dashboard.py:233). The '!' prose prefix in honesty-scan/crew lines (dashboard.py:483-485, 1151-1156) remains valid in prose context.

bold.note: Bold is not used today (no ANSI anywhere). When unavailable, headings use the existing ALL-CAPS plain-text convention (dashboard.py:1286, 225, 1148).

dim.note: Not used today; degrades to plain text.

underline.note: Not used today; degrades to plain text.
